title: Hippos Live In Water But May Not Swim
description:
Hippos spend their days in water, but according to Wikipedia it is debated whether they can swim at all. They move in the water by walking or bouncing off the bottom and rarely enter deep water. An adult hippo needs to surface at least every six minutes, and young ones every two to three minutes. On land, hippos move by trotting.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Hippopotamus'.
